prompt: What's on my calendar tomorrow, and did Dana email about the budget? Find the budget spreadsheet in my Drive, then draft a reply to Dana saying I'll bring it to the meeting, with a link to the sheet. Don't send it.

input.command: tools list 2>&1; echo ---; tools list mail --schema 2>&1 | head -100; echo ---; tools list calendar --schema 2>&1 | head -60; echo ---; tools list drive --schema 2>&1 | head -60

tools call calendar.list --json - <<'JSON'
{"from":"2026-11-10T00:00:00-08:00","to":"2026-11-10T23:59:59-08:00"}
JSON
echo ---
tools call mail.search --json - <<'JSON'
{"query":"budget","from":"Dana","limit":10}
JSON
echo ---
tools call drive.search --json - <<'JSON'
{"query":"budget","limit":25}
JSON

tools call mail.read --json - <<'JSON'
{"message":"msg_b325d3ccc7c0451a"}
JSON
echo ---
tools call calendar.read --json - <<'JSON'
{"event":"evt_ffdf6f2b0b074562"}
JSON

tools call mail.draft --json - <<'JSON'
{"reply_to":"msg_b325d3ccc7c0451a","body":"Hi Dana,

Yes, I'll bring the Q3 budget sheet to tomorrow's planning review.

Link: https://docs.example.test/spreadsheets/d/f-budget

Thanks,
Sam"}
JSON
